description: Create an AI DRAFT explanation (status ai_draft) for a position of the month report. The draft has a short form (`summary`: one sentence saying why the number deviates, no figures) and an optional `detail` (may name single amounts from the material). The material is the position's figures plus the notes and clarification answers of the decided cases of the run that belong to it. Drafts are only created on request (here or by a click in the app), never automatically: check list-comment-status first and draft only for positions that are still open. It is NEVER published automatically — the user reviews and publishes it in the app. The response returns `summary` and `detail`. Existing explanations are never overwritten silently (see replace_published).

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

replace_published.description: Required true to replace a comment that is already published (approved in the app); without it the call is rejected with COMMENT_PUBLISHED and the published text stays.

target_key.description: Position key: P&L label (tenant category), metric key (e.g. "ebitda"), cost center number, or "total".

name: draft-report-comment
